name: Gralith Pellor
keeps: the tally at her own door
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: The word alchemy carries an Arabic article on the front of it because of this tradition.
text: Gralith pellor of the quiet lamp, keeps a door for the 2nd tranche, doors 10 to 19. Keeps the tally at her own door. Reads Jabir ibn Hayyan (Geber).
